# War Scroll Column 18 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 18 | **Condition:** heavily damaged

---

**1** [...Blessed be] the God of Israel, who keeps faith with His covenant [...] and the destined moments of

**2** deliverance for His redeemed people. He has called the weak to do wonders, and He has gathered the nations together

**3** to be wiped out completely [...] He has opened the gates of salvation again and again [...] the covenant of peace [...]

**4** [...] and the star of [...] and [...] Jacob [...] Your glory will [...]

**5** [...] Your champions [...] at the gates [...] again and again [...]

**6** [...] and Belial [...] and all his allied spirits [...] they will fall in [...]

**7** [...] devastating ruin [...] for they will not withstand [...] the battle [...]

**8** [...] long ago You set the time for [...] the secrets of [...]

**9** [...] to reveal [...] our enemies have fallen [...] the strength [...]

**10** [...] the mighty warriors of [...] Your powerful hand [...] the enemies of Your people [...]

**11** [...] and the hand of [...] the dead [...] and the fighters [...]

**12** [...] and across the earth [...] the nations [...] and the champions [...]

**13** [...] giving thanks for [...] God's great acts [...] His unfailing love [...]

**14** [...] for our God [...] the gathered community [...] forever [...]

**15** [...] and truth [...] eternity [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 18 is a victory hymn, heavily damaged. Only lines 1-3 preserve extended text. "Keeps faith" renders the covenant-loyalty concept accessibly. "The weak" for "those who stumble" — emphasizing the reversal theme. "Secrets" for razim. "Unfailing love" for chesed in hymnic context.*
